explanation: Nick is Daisy's cousin and Gatsby's neighbour on Long Island. Fitzgerald considered other titles, including Trimalchio in West Egg, before settling on The Great Gatsby.

claims.text: The narrator of The Great Gatsby is Nick Carraway.
